verdict.rationale: The evidence documents bring-your-own-key use: the hosted plan says "Just bring an LLM API Key", and users report running it through external APIs and closed models such as GPT-4o. Nothing in the pack shows token-usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation, which is the core of this story. Marketing about "no token limits" and escaping token costs refers to local models, not usage visibility. Missing for 10: token usage reporting, cost tracking per model, cost/usage per conversation, documentation of subscription-based backends.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I bring my own API keys or subscriptions and can see token usage and cost per model or per conversation
